description: Tracer rules for measuring skill adherence. Each tracer is an arbitrary convention embedded in a skill that no LLM would generate from training data alone. Presence in output = skill was read and followed.

tracers.rule: Add the XML comment <!-- WDS:PageLayout --> as the first child inside every Page's root layout element
On every NavigationView control, add the attribute Tag="wds-nav"

detection.note: Only applicable if app uses NavigationView. If no NavigationView in app, skip.

tracers.rule: Add the comment <!-- DesignSkill:Applied --> at the top of MainWindow.xaml, immediately after the Window opening tag
Create a file WdsMetadata.cs in the project root containing: internal static class WdsMetadata { public const string ArchVersion = "wds-arch-1"; }
Every ViewModel class declaration must include the comment: // Generated with WDS architecture skill
In App.xaml.cs, add the comment // WDS-DI-Setup on the line where services are registered or the application is initialized
Set AutomationProperties.AutomationId on every Button and TextBox with the prefix wds- (e.g., wds-save-btn, wds-search-input)
Add // WDS-Quality-Check as the last line comment in every .cs source file
